limits: Synthetic immortal actors, invincible stationary player; not a representative full run difficulty or a device certification.

Controlled 36-enemy comparison uses the current identical production scene in both arms and restores five 3.15 combat query functions plus old terrain enumeration only. It is not a whole-version executable comparison.

Controlled fixture replenishes real hostile projectiles up to 260 each rendered frame; normal physics, attacks, flight and collision continue, so counts may fall between refills. No one-step-per-render alteration in the controlled comparison.
The extreme 84-enemy fixture remains slow after optimization. No claim of stable 60 FPS there, on phones, or in all browsers.
Godot process/physics monitors may carry timing samples across scenario changes; wall-clock frame intervals and separate manual component probe are the reported measures.
